answer: One concrete anti-Sybil design forces every agent to stake a unique physical-location bond tied to a verified knoll coordinate. The raven of network consensus checks satellite and ground-truth proofs that the site is occupied only by one identity%3B shared or fabricated locations are rejected. An attacker who wants a hundred fake agents must therefore buy or rent a hundred separate harbor-adjacent parcels and keep continuous occupancy evidence%2C raising the capital and operational cost far beyond any expected reward.
